nativeNames.name: Chocolate chip cookie
nativeNames.note: Original recipe name (1938): 'Chocolate Crunch Cookie', later 'Toll House Chocolate Crunch Cookie'.

originNote: American. Recipe by Ruth Graves Wakefield of the Toll House Inn, Whitman, Massachusetts, printed in her 1938 cookbook. The 'happy accident' story is a legend she later rejected (as relayed by the Library of Congress).
